title: Young Messi Fan Moves to Pakistan
main_content:
A 5-year-old Afghan boy who became world famous earlier this year has fled his country.

A photograph of Murtaza Ahmadi first appeared on the Internet in January. He was wearing a homemade soccer jersey that looked like the one worn by Lionel Messi, the Argentinian soccer star.

The photograph spread quickly on the Internet. Eventually, Messi himself heard about the boy and sent him a soccer ball and signed jerseys.

The story seemed to have a happy ending.

But after the news spread, the Ahmadi family started receiving threatening telephone calls and even a letter from the Taliban.

The Press says the Taliban have yet to comment.

Murtaza’s father said that at first he was not sure who was responsible for all the phone calls.

About one month ago, the family of eight quietly fled to Pakistan.

But Murtaza Ahmadi has not given up on soccer.

questions.question: How did Murtaza Ahmadi become famous?
options: A photograph of him wearing a homemade soccer jersey went viral.
He was featured in a documentary about children in Afghanistan.
He won a local soccer tournament in his hometown.
His family appeared on a talk show discussing their life.
questions.answer: A photograph of him wearing a homemade soccer jersey went viral.

questions.question: Who is Lionel Messi?
options: An Argentinian soccer star known worldwide.
The coach of the Afghan national soccer team.
A child athlete who also became famous on the internet.
questions.answer: An Argentinian soccer star known worldwide.

questions.question: Why have Murtaza Ahmadi and his family fled to Pakistan?
options: They were offered a better life opportunity in Pakistan.
They received threatening calls from the Taliban.
Murtaza was selected to train with a professional soccer club.
They wanted to escape the harsh winter in Afghanistan.
questions.answer: They received threatening calls from the Taliban.
